title: Kinetic Trust Protocol (KTP): RFC Series
description: KTP specifies environment-derived authorization for autonomous agents: authority recomputed from current conditions rather than issued in advance, under the constraint that an agent's autonomy must never exceed what the environment can support. The series defines the Context Signals catalogue (what is measurable), the Risk Factors scoring layer (six weighted inputs and the Soul veto, which carries sovereignty constraints), and the enforcement, federation, audit and conformance machinery around them. This archive contains the RFC specification series.
